Game Overview

In Tangram Puzzle Guess the Number, the core idea is straightforward: decipher hidden numbers using tangram pieces in a blend of geometry and strategy. Assemble each piece precisely to reveal numbers concealed within complex shapes. Progress through various levels by perfecting your logic, experiencing math and art in this addictive puzzle challenge.
